Wages: $79,500- $85,000 (in line with experience)
Sector: Operations & Production Technology

The Opportunity Our client is a leading name in high-end joinery and construction solutions, currently undergoing a significant technological expansion. As they scale their operations to meet a growing portfolio of large-scale projects, they are seeking a forward-thinking Automation Technician to act as the bridge between traditional craftsmanship and cutting-edge manufacturing.
This is a strategic role designed to maximize the efficiency of a brand-new robotic and CNC infrastructure. You will be responsible for ensuring peak machine uptime, optimizing cycle times, and integrating real-time data diagnostics to drive precision and production volume.

Key Responsibilities

• System Integration & Programming: Develop and optimize PLC and HMI systems to streamline workflows from design to execution. You will play a key role in robotic orchestration, calibrating assembly arms for high-precision tasks like finishing and sorting.
• Technical Diagnostics & Maintenance: Act as the primary responder for complex faults across CNC woodworking machinery (cutting, drilling, edge-banding) and automated material handling systems.
• Predictive Strategy: Implement diagnostic schedules for pneumatic, electrical, and mechanical components to mitigate downtime.
• Operational Optimization: Use production line data to identify bottlenecks and adjust machine parameters to increase throughput.
• Growth & Commissioning: Lead the installation and commissioning of new sensors, conveyors, and safety systems as the facility continues its digital transformation.

Required Qualifications & Experience
• Educational Background: Diploma or Degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or Industrial Automation.
• Industry Expertise: Minimum of 1 years’ experience maintaining high-end CNC machinery (e.g., Homag, Biesse, SCM) and robotic systems (e.g., KUKA, ABB, FANUC).
• Programming Skills: Proven proficiency in PLC programming (Siemens TIA Portal, Allen-Bradley, or similar) and HMI design.
• Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of pneumatic systems, servo-drives, and industrial networking (EtherCAT, Profinet).
• Analytical Mindset: Ability to interpret complex electrical schematics and mechanical blueprints.

Why Apply?
This is a rare chance to work within a facility that is truly embracing the "digital thread" of manufacturing. You will be at the forefront of industrial automation on the Gold Coast, working with a team that values surgical precision and technological innovation.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Mechanical Engineering Technicians to join our team on a full-time permanent basis, supporting operations at our Parilla site in South Australia. 

As a valuable member of our team, this position will play a vital role in the success of our operations. If you are reliable, energetic and have a passion for agriculture we would love to hear from you.

The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, able to work both independently and as part of a team. Reporting directly to the Farm Workshop Manager you will be working in an outdoor farm environment. 

An attractive remuneration package between $70,000 - $90,000 is available to the right candidates. 

Duties include:

•	Identify, develop, and implement equipment upgrades, modifications, and new installs to reduce risk, improve capability, quality, and reliability, and lower operational costs.
•	Set up, operate, calibrate, and maintain machinery to ensure daily production requirements are met without negative impacts to the customer or business.
•	Conduct testing and evaluation of farm machinery and production equipment to ensure operational reliability.
•	Collect and analyse machine data, carrying out complex computations and preparing drawings.
•	Monitor equipment performance, identifying operational issues. 
•	Participate in quality improvement initiatives and projects.
•	Provide technical support and guidance to the operations team to ensure proper machine functionality.
•	Adjust machine controls whilst monitoring the production process to ensure quality production and minimal unplanned stops.
•	Assist the maintenance manager in diagnosing mechanical and hydraulic system faults.
•	Ensure all relevant safety objectives and legal requirements are observed for all work completed.
•	Conduct all duties in accordance with procedures as specified by the quality system to ensure that designs and finished work are within specifications, regulations and provisions.
•	All other requirements as directed to achieve business objectives.

Requirements:

•	Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent) OR at least 3 years of relevant experience.
•	Experience in mechanical services. 
•	Knowledge of tools, equipment, materials, methods, and practices of engine repair, mechanical and electrical systems, and maintenance.
•	Knowledge of standards and regulations associated with a mechanical workshop plant and equipment.
•	Ability to confidently diagnose faults on site and in the workshop.
•	Unrestricted Class C Drivers Licence (essential)

result.description:
## Cyber Security Engineer
## Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Cyber Security Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in safeguarding our software systems, applications, and digital infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining robust security solutions that are fully integrated into our development and operational environments. This role suits a technically adept professional with a strong background in secure software development, vulnerability management, and security architecture who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced setting.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and implement cyber security software applications and systems, ensuring they are fully integrated, well-documented, and aligned with organisational security standards
- Develop and enforce secure coding practices across the software development lifecycle, embedding security controls at every stage from design through to deployment
- Conduct comprehensive security testing, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing on software, systems, and infrastructure to identify and address potential risks
- Collaborate closely with software developers and engineering teams to identify, prioritise, and remediate security vulnerabilities and coding weaknesses in a timely manner
- Participate in code reviews, offering expert security guidance and ensuring that development teams adhere to established security frameworks and best practices
- Design and maintain secure application programming interfaces (APIs) and libraries for use across software and application environments
- Assess the security posture of third-party software components, open-source libraries, and vendor integrations, providing recommendations to mitigate associated risks
- Perform binary and static code analysis scans on software applications to detect vulnerabilities before release into production environments
- Monitor, analyse, and respond to security incidents and threats across the organisation's systems, networks, and applications
- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve security policies, standards, and documentation to reflect evolving threat landscapes and regulatory requirements
- Support the integration of security tooling and automation into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous security testing and compliance validation
- Liaise with internal stakeholders, including IT, compliance, and senior leadership, to provide clear reporting on security risks, incidents, and remediation progress
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security engineering or information security role, ideally within a complex enterprise environment
- Strong proficiency in secure software development practices and knowledge of common vulnerability frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 and CVSS
- Hands-on experience conducting vulnerability assessments, security testing, and code analysis using industry-standard tools
- Solid understanding of network security, identity and access management, encryption protocols, and security architecture principles
- Experience integrating security controls into DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines
- Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, PowerShell, or Bash
- Familiarity with cloud security concepts and platforms, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex security risks and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative, team-oriented approach
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent
- Experience working within regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, or government
- Familiarity with Australian Privacy Act requirements, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) Essential Eight
- Exposure to threat modelling methodologies and security risk management frameworks
- Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) platforms and endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a forward-thinking organisation that places cyber security at the heart of its technology strategy, giving you genuine influence over how security is designed and delivered
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and conference attendance
- Enjoy a flexible, hybrid working arrangement that supports a healthy work-life balance
- Work within a collaborative and inclusive team culture that values innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement
- Competitive remuneration package with clear pathways for career progression into senior and leadership roles
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Due to their expanding international footprint of advisors and corporate offices spanning Melbourne, Queensland, and Dubai, their infrastructure requires enterprise-grade engineering and now seek an experienced Computer?Network and System Engineer to join the team in Hampton East, Victoria. 

?? 

The Role: 

This is a full time role with an annual salary set at $150,000 plus superannuation, and will be based in Hampton East, Victoria. 

? 

The Responsibilities: 

Design, deploy, and manage secure, high-availability Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless environments across all corporate offices, including Hampton East (VIC), Mermaid Beach (QLD), and Dubai. 

Implement advanced networking technologies and configure routers, firewalls, and network switches to prioritise high-bandwidth traffic, ensuring seamless VoIP communication.  

Create, update, and maintain detailed technical documentation, including network inventories, configuration change logs, maintenance procedures, and fault resolution records. 

Design and deploy network configurations, incorporating high-availability routing protocols, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), Quality of Service (QoS) rules, and secure site-to-site VPN tunnels. 

Implement SoftwareDefined Networking (SDN) and develop programmatic, APIdriven workflows across network hardware using automation tools such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, and RESTful integrations to improve operational efficiency and system reliability. 

Monitor and analyse network traffic, capacity, and utilisation metrics, and evaluate endtoend network infrastructure performance across all corporate office locations. 

Evaluate and propose technical enhancements to network operations, interconnected server infrastructure, internal hardware, distributed PropTech applications, and hybrid operational environments. 

Optimise 4K media-rendering architectures and secure localised Network attached Storage (NAS) configurations, improving internal high-volume data-pipeline workflows for the marketing division. 

Oversee network and system configurations to ensure smooth data flows between real estate-specific APIs, external listing syndications (e.g., Realestate.com.au, Domain), and internal master CRMs. 

Provision, test, and deploy complex server networks, cloud systems (Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory / Entra ID), and endpoint systems using modern Mobile Device Management (MDM) software. 

Formulate comprehensive testing strategies to validate network throughput, failover systems, and server redundancy, ensuring the agency maintains its strict zero-downtime metric during business hours. 

Provide expert troubleshooting and fault-finding services to isolate, diagnose, and resolve intricate network bugs, hardware failures, system anomalies, or cross-platform software conflicts. 

Troubleshoot complex issues across hardware, networks, software, database applications, servers, and workstations, coordinating with internal teams and vendors, and maintaining high service standards. 

Actively contribute to ZED Real Estate’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) by supporting the implementation and upkeep of its policies, procedures and controls, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information in alignment with ISO/IEC?27001. 

Design and execute network security baselines, including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Zero-Trust conditional access rules, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and advanced endpoint detection systems. 

Architect and manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) lifecycle workflows to enforce continuous security baselines across automated user onboarding and offboarding frameworks. 

Create, test, and preserve robust data backup structures, comprehensive disaster recovery workflows, and Business Continuity Plans (BCP) to secure sensitive real estate escrow accounts and high-net-worth data. 

 

The Requirements: 

A Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related ICT Major. 

At least 5 years of relevant professional experience as a Network Engineer, Systems Engineer, or ICT Systems Administrator in a corporate setting 

Professional infrastructure certifications are highly regarded (e.g., Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, CompTIA Security+). 

At least 5 years demonstrated experience of core networking models and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, VPN, switching, routing). 

At least 5 years experience managing corporate directory platforms and infrastructure identities (Microsoft cloud technologies, including Microsoft 365, Entra and Intune). 

Must have over 5 years’ experience to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network infrastructure devices, including wireless access points, firewall, routers, switches, controllers 

Must know how to setup virtual configurations in VMWare vSphere and Hyper-V 

At least 5 years of experience with server virtualisation, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and hybrid integration projects. 

Strong analytical skills and sound administration skills 

Quick to grasp new ideas and concepts 

Ability to work to tight deadlines and under immense pressure at times
